title: The month ahead: CPI 14 Oct, FOMC 28 Oct, ECB 29 Oct, BoJ 30 Oct, BoE 5 Nov
summary: US September CPI comes out on 14 October. The Fed decides on 28 October after September’s hike. The ECB (deposit rate 2.00%) meets on 29 October, the Bank of Japan (0.75%) on 30 October, and the Bank of England on 5 November.
ict: ICT’s Month 1 assignment: put every high-impact release on your chart and log how price behaves around it. These are the moments of manipulation and expansion. October also opens Q4: anchor your IPDA look-back on 1 September and cast forward 20/40/60 trading days to see where the next quarterly shift may fall.
